description: Translate up to 200 text segments in a single call - the same result that would otherwise take 200 separate calls to translate a whole file. Markdown, HTML and {x} placeholders preserved per segment, order and count kept intact, source language auto-detected, automatic fallback across multiple models for uptime, providers that train on submitted prompts excluded. A single string also works. No account, no API key. Try GET /translate/sample.

preserve_format.description: Keep markdown syntax, HTML tags and {x}/{{x}} placeholders unchanged, translating only the surrounding natural-language text - useful for localizing UI strings or templated content.

source_lang.description: Source language code. Omit to auto-detect.

target_lang.description: Target language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'en', 'fr', 'ja'.

text.description: Text to translate - a single string, or an array of up to 200 segments to translate together in one call (batch/bulk translation), preserving order and count.

name: translate

detected_source_lang.description: Auto-detected source language, when not supplied.

text.description: The original input text or segments.

translated_text.description: Translated text - a string, or an array aligned with the input segments for batch requests.

x402_receipt.description: Billing and provenance receipt, including segments_processed for batch calls.

title: Translate Text
